ns2:group.ns2:description:
Do you often feel like people are laughing at you or constantly watching your every move?Do other people’s eyes really matter as much as you think they do?
In reality, feelings of insecurity, embarrassment, and fear of “losing face” are often mental illusions. Most people are far too busy with their own lives to pay close attention to you — certainly not in the way you imagine.
This video explores the spotlight effect, a psychological bias that makes us believe we are being noticed and judged far more than we actually are. Breaking free from this instinct is a key step toward psychological maturity and true mental freedom.
